title: Install the Tugra agent
subtitle: One click installs the agent on the servers Coolify manages, using Coolify's own SSH keys. The keys never leave the Coolify server.

card.title: Install on {count} servers
card.none: Every server here already has an agent, or none can be installed this way.
card.ownerOnly: Only a team owner can install agents this way. Ask an owner, or use the install command of a server in the list.

probe.title: Checking first. Nothing is changed yet.
probe.done: Check finished: {ready} ready, {skipped} left alone, {failed} cannot be installed.

code.skipped_present: A Tugra agent is already here.
code.skipped_foreign: Another Tugra hub runs an agent here. Left untouched.
code.auth_failed: The server did not accept Coolify's key.
code.hostkey_mismatch: The server that enrolled is not the one that was probed. Stopped and removed.
code.no_key_file: Coolify's key file was not found.
code.bad_target: This server cannot be a target.
code.needs_root: Needs root or passwordless sudo. Use the manual command.
code.sudo_tty: sudo asks for a terminal. Use the manual command.
code.arch_unsupported: This CPU architecture is not supported.
code.pull_failed: Could not download the agent image.
code.hub_unreachable_from_target: The server cannot reach your hub.
code.enroll_timeout: The agent did not connect in time. Rolled back.
code.unsupported_proxy: Behind a tunnel or jump host. Use the manual command.
code.agent_left_behind: The install did not finish, but an agent was found on this server. Remove the container named tugra-agent and the volume tugra-agent-data there.
code.install_unconfirmed: The install did not finish and the server could not be checked afterwards. Look for a container named tugra-agent on it and remove it if it is there.

what.keys: Tugra uses the SSH keys Coolify already has. The keys stay on the Coolify server. They are never copied, shown or sent to Tugra.
what.probe: First a read-only check of each server. Nothing is changed.
what.install: Then one container, the Tugra agent, is started on each server that is ready. Nothing else on it is touched.
what.existing: A server that already runs an agent is left alone.
what.undo: You can remove the agents again with one click.
what.consent: This permission ends after 2 hours, or as soon as the run is finished.
what.audit: Every step is written to the audit log.

run.heading: Servers
run.installBody: The agent will be installed on {count} server(s). Each one asks for the same permission you gave.
run.removeTitle: Remove the agents this run installed
run.removeBody: The agent container installed by this run is stopped and removed from {count} server(s). Nothing else is touched.
run.manualHint: Use the install command for this server in the list above.
run.hostKeyPinned: Coolify's own record of the server's key was checked.

error.confirm_mismatch: The number does not match. Type it exactly.
error.run_in_progress: Some of these servers are already being installed.
error.agent_offline: The agent on the Coolify server is offline.
error.agent_too_old: Update the agent on the Coolify server first.
error.grant_expired: The permission for this run ended. Start a new check.
error.nothing_ready: No server is ready to install.
error.nothing_to_remove: There is no agent from this run left to remove.
error.unknown_server: One of those servers is not in this Coolify.
error.server_in_use: That server still runs apps or databases, or is part of a move. Move or delete those first.
error.forbidden: Only a team owner can do this.

gap.title: Some source servers have no agent yet
gap.body: A move needs a Tugra agent on both servers. Add the agent first, then start the move.
gap.sshHint: Install them in one click from the Coolify page, using Coolify's own SSH keys.
gap.commandHint: Or run the install command on each server, or use your provider's console or cloud-init.
gap.unverified: Tugra could not check which servers have an agent. Try again.
gap.dryRunNote: A dry run still works. A real run starts once every source server has an agent.
